title: 6 kWp Solar, 6 kW Inverter: Pareho Ba?
premise: kWp is the panels' DC rating at test conditions; inverter kW is its AC output. Arrays can be larger than the inverter (DC-to-AC ratio); excess at peak is clipped, which is normal if designed correctly.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

clip.kwLabel: Abot na sa max ng inverter

sources: Sources: NREL TP-5K00-82812 (Inverter Loading Ratio); Penn State
AE 868 datasheet guide; U.S. DOE inverter basics (checked 24 Nov 2026)

cues.text: 6 kWp na solar, 6 kW na inverter. Pareho ba 'yan?
cues.say: Six kilowatt peak na solar, six kilowatt na inverter. Pareho ba 'yan?

cues.text: Hindi. Ang kWp ay DC rating ng panels sa test conditions.
cues.say: Hindi. Ang kilowatt peak ay D-C rating ng panels sa test conditions.

cues.text: Ang kW ng inverter ay AC output na kaya nitong ilabas.
cues.say: Ang kilowatt ng inverter ay A-C output na kaya nitong ilabas.

cues.text: Puwedeng mas malaki ang panels kaysa inverter.

cues.say: Tinatawag itong D-C to A-C ratio.

cues.text: Kapag sobra ang DC sa tanghali, may clipping.
cues.say: Kapag sobra ang D-C sa tanghali, may clipping.

cues.text: Normal 'yan, basta tama ang design at kalkula.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

sources.title: Solar Integration: Inverters and Grid Services Basics
excerpts: Inverters change the variable direct current (DC) output of PV into alternating current (AC) for the grid and household use.

sources.title: The Effect of Inverter Loading Ratio on Energy Estimate Bias (NREL/TP-5K00-82812)
excerpts: Inverter loading ratio (ILR) = rated DC power / rated AC power.
Clipping appears as a flat line at or near the inverter's AC capacity when DC power exceeds it.

sources.publisher: National Renewable Energy Laboratory / Penn State AE 868
sources.title: PV module ratings at Standard Test Conditions; Interpreting PV manufacturer datasheets
excerpts: STC: 1000 W/m² irradiance, 25°C cell temperature, AM1.5 spectrum.
Temperature coefficient of power is negative: output falls as cell temperature rises above 25°C.

caption.main:
6 kWp solar, 6 kW inverter: pareho ba? Hindi! Ang kWp ay DC rating ng panels, ang kW ng inverter ay AC output. Puwedeng mas malaki ang panels (DC-to-AC ratio), at normal ang konting clipping basta tama ang design. ⚙️

SoSmart viewers, ano'ng nakasulat sa quote n'yo? 👇
